description: This file defines an interface for managing product reviews within the sales manager application. It includes method signatures for retrieving product reviews based on customer, product, or both, and extends a generic entity service.

classes.name: ProductReviewService
classes.description: Interface for operations related to product reviews, extending generic service to handle ProductReview entities.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product reviews made by a specific customer.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reviews for a specific product.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reviews for a specific product in a specific language.

methods.name: getByProductAndCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a specific product review by product ID and customer ID.
